repairs.text: Strongest feature: Aron Ra carefully acknowledges uncertainty about possessing free will and identifies continuing dispute, thereby preventing Hernandez from treating libertarian origination as an established premise from which an immaterial subject automatically follows. Principal limitation: Calibrated uncertainty provides no substantive agency theory and therefore leaves unanswered how rational inference, intellectual integrity, moral responsibility, and authentic authorship remain intelligible within a causally ordered world. Live burden: He must demonstrate how causally influenced persons recognize reasons, govern conduct, and deserve accountability without requiring an uncaused soul, thus answering Hernandez’s practical consequences rather than solely withholding assent from their disputed metaphysical premise. Locked score: The evidence warrants the locked score of 75, because premise-level resistance is coherent, precise, charitable, and inference-blocking, while remaining incomplete as an explanation of responsible agency.

Strongest feature: Aron Ra candidly marks his expertise limit while tracing bodily damage through physical signaling, reception, and interpretation into pain, offering a concrete mediation account without pretending to possess detailed neurological knowledge. Principal limitation: This causal outline explains transmission and functional response, but it does not establish why neural processing has subjective painful character, while his appeal to interpretation leaves unspecified what performs the interpreting that Hernandez assigns to a conscious subject. Live burden: He must connect physical mediation to the asserted difference between objective bodily processes and experienced pain, showing that the mechanism generates subjective character rather than merely correlating with or supporting it, and must distinguish production from dependence. Locked score: The locked score of 71 recognizes a relevant, calibrated reply that remains explanatorily incomplete.
